# adhd-status

> Free, open source (MIT) ADHD-friendly status board skill for Claude Code and AI coding agents. Say STATUS and the agent replies with one tiny Task | Why | Status table (4 rows max) and exactly one next step to click or run. Nothing forgotten.

Author and owner: Mauricio Alonso Moya Tapia. License: MIT (OSI-approved).

## What it does

- Sweeps the whole conversation (built-in completion check, nothing else to install) so no task, pending command or promise is dropped.
- Checks results itself: reads the terminal or verifies the effect; never asks the user to paste output.
- One task per thread; finished threads report to their parent, archive, and offer a "Back to parent" button.
- Hub mode: a ROADMAP.md file summarizes every task in flight; the hub only consolidates and leaves each child thread's merge or deploy step in that thread.
- Hard to miss (1.7.0): loads on every way the user says status and on done or hand-back reports; optional hooks make it certain. Plugin eval 2026-11-03: 0.96 with the skill vs 0.50 without.
- Suggests compacting the context at milestones.
- GitHub Action (1.8.1): `uses: maumoya/adhd-status@v1.8.1` checks saved status replies in CI and fails on format breaks; listed on the GitHub Marketplace as "ADHD status reply lint".

- [Example reply](https://github.com/maumoya/adhd-status/blob/main/examples/status-reply.md)

## Install

- Plain skill: clone github.com/maumoya/adhd-status and link skills/adhd-status into ~/.claude/skills/
- Plugin: this repository is a Claude Code plugin marketplace (.claude-plugin/)
